capabilities: Query vault files, tags and tasks using SQL in sqlseal code blocks
Create tables from CSV files in the vault and query them with SELECT statements
Define multiple tables per snippet and reference tables across snippets in the same note
Update source markdown files when interacting with tasks through the tasks table
extras: Documentation lives outside the README at hypersphere.blog/sql-seal. The README warns the plugin can modify vault files (saving variables as comments in .sql/.sqlseal files and updating markdown when editing tasks via the tasks table) and advises backing up files; the author also runs a Discord channel for support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run SQL queries over vault content or treat CSV files as relational tables.
summary: SQL code-block plugin that queries vault files, tags and tasks with SQL and renders CSV files as queryable database tables.
